Package org.vafer.jdependency

Interface DeclaredDependencies

public interface DeclaredDependencies
Extracts class references that are declared in resources rather than in bytecode (like `META-INF/services` files) so classes that are only loaded reflectively still show up in the dependency graph. Each declaration is an edge from a trigger class to a target class: if the trigger is reachable, the target needs to be kept as well.
